name: SAT-SUN_WHITE_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. R9-SA56 450 x 150 (one size), R25, 6 / 16 (edge 6 + border 10). SAT-SUN 75 C, top 37 (37/75/38), ink 366 (42/366/42). The dash is a spaced bar, not the AS 1744 hyphen: measured on the sheet SAT 42-181 (139), bar 198-236 (38 wide, y 70-80), SUN 254-409 (155); drawn as two words 73 apart with a 38 x 10 bar at x 198 (SAT and SUN widths are the Series C font's, 139 / 155).
